title: Loss Prevention Checklist Form
subtitle: A practical execution checklist for loss prevention that connects identity, observations and evidence, decision authority, exception ownership, and accountable closeout.
description: An original retail-operations execution checklist for loss prevention covering loss-prevention controls and evidence, evidence references, authorization, escalation, operating limits, disposition, and handoff without copying a third-party form.
use_case: Use when a authorized loss-prevention lead opens one loss prevention record to execute required steps, record conditions, route exceptions, make a release decision, and hand off open work; closure requires a documented outcome, evidence route, responsible owner, and recipient acknowledgment.

sections.title: Loss prevention checklist identity and routing
sections.guidance: Connect this checklist to one location, operating period, accountable owner, and review route.

blocks.label: Loss prevention event scope, trigger, affected area, and prior handoff

fields.label: Loss Prevention scope and routing context

sections.title: Loss prevention readiness and execution sequence
sections.guidance: Mark each independently verified step; explain any item that cannot be completed as planned.

blocks.label: Loss prevention steps
items: Shift, store, authorized reviewer, and control scope linked
Keys, seals, alarms, doors, and restricted areas checked
High-value, return, receiving, and cash interfaces reviewed
Camera or device status recorded without credentials
Known maintenance and access exceptions reviewed
Objective observations separated from reports or assumptions
Evidence references stored in the approved restricted system
No confrontation, pursuit, search, or detention initiated by this form
Escalation followed current authority and privacy limits
Open control gap and next-shift handoff recorded

blocks.label: Operating boundary
blocks.guidance: This form does not authorize surveillance expansion, profiling, confrontation, pursuit, search, detention, accusation, or access to restricted evidence. Record objective facts and minimum necessary personal information. Keep footage, credentials, and sensitive evidence in approved restricted systems. Follow applicable privacy, security, legal-request, and emergency policy and route decisions to the authorized professional reviewer.

sections.title: Loss prevention conditions and supporting evidence
sections.guidance: Record what was actually observed; a checked condition is a routing signal, not a conclusion.

blocks.label: Condition indicators reviewed
items: Key, seal, door, alarm, or restricted-area discrepancy
Camera or security device unavailable
High-value, receiving, return, or cash control gap
Unexpected access or activity observed
Reported loss lacks objective supporting facts
Evidence or personal information needs restricted handling
Immediate threat or emergency response needed
Matter exceeds role, policy, or investigation authority

blocks.label: Observation, location, time, people affected, source, and evidence reference

fields.label: Loss Prevention observation and evidence detail

sections.title: Loss prevention exceptions, escalation, and release decision
sections.guidance: Give each exception an immediate action, owner, due point, escalation route, and disposition.

blocks.label: Exception and stop indicators
items: Immediate safety or threat condition
Access or security control cannot be restored
Evidence preservation needs specialist support
Personal information or footage access is restricted
Law-enforcement or legal request received
Investigation or disposition exceeds authority

blocks.label: Loss prevention release decision and authorization

sections.title: Loss prevention outcome, closeout, and handoff
sections.guidance: Make the final outcome, remaining limitation, next action, owner, and acceptance visible.

blocks.label: Loss prevention closeout controls
items: Objective observation and source type recorded
Restricted evidence location and custodian linked
Affected control has a temporary owner
Required management or specialist review assigned
Next shift received limits and open actions
Final outcome avoids unsupported accusation

blocks.label: Outcome verification, recipient acceptance, and reopen decision
Remaining limitation, action, owner, due point, and recipient route
Unresolved work, customer or staff impact, evidence location, and handoff message

fields.label: Loss Prevention residual work and handoff

blocks.label: Checklist closeout acknowledgment
blocks.guidance: Acknowledgment records preparation and receipt; it is not a legal, safety, or professional certification.
